prompt_text: How much does nonprofit donor CRM cost
response_text:
Nonprofit donor CRM costs typically range from **$45 to $500+ per month**, depending on the platform, organization size, constituent count, and features, with annual budgets often falling between **$540 and $3,600** for most small to mid-sized nonprofits.[1][2][4]

### Pricing Comparison of Top Options (2026 Data)
| Platform              | Starting Monthly Price | Typical Annual Cost     | Pricing Model          | Notes[1][3][4][7] |
|-----------------------|------------------------|-------------------------|------------------------|-------------------|
| **Little Green Light** | $45                   | $540–$1,260            | Per constituent count | Most affordable; 10% off for annual prepay; best for small/budget-conscious orgs. |
| **Bloomerang**        | $125                  | $1,500–$3,600          | Per constituent count | Unlimited users; strong donor retention tools. |
| **Neon CRM**          | $99                   | $1,188–$3,600          | Per org revenue       | Unlimited records; good for growing orgs. |
| **DonorPerfect**      | $99                   | $1,188–$3,000+         | Per constituent count | Mid-range flexibility; tiered options up to $649/mo. |
| **Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud** | $60/user     | $10,000–$30,000+       | Per user              | 10 free licenses; high customization but implementation costs extra. |
| **DonorDock**         | $500                  | N/A                    | Flat fee              | Unlimited contacts; all-in-one for growing orgs. |

### Additional Cost Factors
- **Scaling and add-ons**: Prices increase with more contacts/records (e.g., Little Green Light to $135/mo for 50,000 constituents) or extras like fundraising ($40+/mo) or volunteer tools ($119+/mo).[1][3][4]
- **Hidden fees**: Expect 2.2–3% + $0.30 per donation transaction, onboarding/setup, data migration, training (2–4 weeks staff time), and premium support.[1][2][5][6]
- **Free tiers**: Rare and limited; often shift processing fees to donors or require upgrades for full CRM (e.g., Donorbox basic at $0/mo but 3% fee).[1][6]
- **Budget recommendation**: Small orgs should allocate $540–$1,500/year; avoid Salesforce unless you have technical staff.[1][2] Always factor in 3–5 year growth to prevent unexpected scaling costs.[5]
